title: Final Answers
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct luminous efficiencies for two selected light sources.

title: Definition of Efficiency
description: Important Criteria: The student should define luminous efficiency and explain its significance in the context of light sources.

title: Energy Range Specification
description: Important Criteria: The student must mention the visible wavelength range (4000 – 7600 A) relevant to the calculation of luminous efficiency.

title: Energy Loss Consideration
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss energy losses due to conduction and convection as part of the efficiency analysis.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that the units used for efficiency are consistent and correctly interpreted as ratios.
